newsitem.title: JAPAN: Sharp, Sony tie in plasma display development.
newsitem.headline: Sharp, Sony tie in plasma display development.

text.p: Sony Corp and Sharp Corp have agreed to collaborate in development of large-screen plasma display panel using PALC (plasma-addressed liquid crystal) technology, the two firms said on Thursday.
Sony, the licensee of the PALC technology developed by U.S. firm Tektronix Inc, will sub-license the know-how to Sharp, a Sony spokesman said.
Sony and Sharp will jointly develop a 40-inch range, wide viewing-angle flat display, he said.

A plasma display is a flat television display panel. Unlike conventional displays, PDP technology allows for larger screens without an increase in weight or thickness, making it suitable for producing wall-hanging televisions.
Japanese electronics makers, such as NEC Corp, Matsushita Electric Industrial Co, are planning to produce PDPs using different technologies from Sony's.
